text:
Maya Patel: quick design review — playground structured output flow. Prototype: https://redwood.dev/proto/ux-struct-output. Focus areas: schema editor UI (inline defs vs separate panel), tool-calling/fn defs, and run history (how we surface past invocations). @Liam @Samir @Nora please skim before EOD. Screenshots attached: https://photos.redwood/proto/1807654321.png

DesignBot: Automated accessibility scan complete — flagged 6 contrast failures and 2 missing aria attributes. Full report: https://ci.redwood/a11y/1807654321 :warning:

Liam O'Connor: Quick pass — keyboard nav issue: when you expand a function in the schema tree focus jumps to the editor and the tree item loses focus. Suggest roving tabindex or set aria-expanded on the tree headers. Also the focus outline is too faint (1px) — make it more visible for keyboard users.

Samir (Sam) Gupta: Layout question: i'm leaning left-column schema tree + right-column function editor, run history docked below editor. Keeps editor wide for code. Alternative is stacked (schema above editor) which is friendlier on mobile. We could offer a toggle.

Maya Patel: Product asked for run history to be per-playground-run (big) vs per-function-call (inline). Per-function inline is handy for debugging, but could be noisy. Thoughts on a collapsed default with quick expand action?

Nora Li: Copy nit: change "Run details" -> "Invocation details" to reduce ambiguity with the global "Playground run". Also suggest renaming "Add function" -> "Add tool" (customers call them tools). Placeholder suggestion for schema input: "Enter JSON schema or select a type".

Liam O'Connor: Accessibility nit: toolbar icon-only buttons lack aria-labels — we need visually-hidden text for screen readers. Color tokens: body text on light gray panels falls below 4.5:1, increase contrast or adjust bg token.

Samir (Sam) Gupta: Can we support both JSON Schema and a simplified function signature UI? Example quick schema i mocked below (would prefer a compact editor mode):

```
{
  "name": "search_tool",
  "description": "query a docs index",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "query": { "type": "string" },
      "top_k": { "type": "integer", "default": 5 }
    },
    "required": ["query"]
  }
}
```

Maya Patel: Love the compact editor idea. For run history: show input/output diff inline, add quick filters (by tool name, status), and a tiny "Re-run" icon on each invocation. Also allow pinning an invocation to the right panel for side-by-side debugging.

DesignBot: Playground E2E results: keyboard re-run passes, but test playground.test.ts::keyboard-re-run positionRestore fails — cursor position not restored when modal closes. Screenshot + trace: https://ci.redwood/playground/tests/1807654321

Nora Li: One more copy tweak: change "Schema required" microcopy to "Schema (optional — helps structure output)". Feels less scary for new users. Also "Save" CTA should read "Save function" when in function editor to reduce contextual ambiguity.

Liam O'Connor: LGTM once the a11y fixes are in. :+1:

Maya Patel: Thanks — i'll iterate on frames tomorrow and post updated Figma links. Will prototype compact editor + per-function inline run history collapsed by default. Appreciate the quick reviews! :sparkles:
